Spiritual life

Prayer, worship, spiritual conversation and care for our neighbours.

Prayer, guidance and the Word of God

Spiritual foundations for the community’s everyday life.

1 / 4

Community activity

Prayer — the Heart of Our Community

Prayer is the spiritual heart of our community, giving each day a deeper meaning in the presence of God. Before the holy icons, we bring our joys, concerns and prayers for those in need of support.

In the silence of prayer, the human heart opens to God's love, finds peace and draws strength to serve others.

Community activity

Worship

The community’s church provides a place for shared prayer and church life. Worship turns our attention towards Christ and listening to the Word of God.

Gathering before God calls us to repentance, mercy and responsibility for one another. What we hear in church finds expression in our daily actions.

Community activity

Spiritual Guidance — a Path to Inner Renewal

Sometimes what a person needs most is not a ready-made answer, but someone who will listen attentively and help them rediscover their spiritual foundation. Through sincere conversation, prayer and Christian guidance, a person may begin to see life in a new light.

We believe that even amid life's greatest trials, God never leaves anyone without hope.

Community activity

The Word of God — Light Along Life's Journey

Holy Scripture helps us discover a deeper meaning in life and recognise God's presence in everyday circumstances. Reading and reflecting together invite us not only to hear God's Word, but also to put it into practice through our decisions and actions.

Faith becomes truly alive when the Gospel we hear is transformed into love and mercy.

01

Worship and the church

The church is a place of shared prayer, listening to the Word of God and turning to Christ. Icons invite attention, while church life calls us to repentance, mercy and responsibility towards our neighbours. Please ask the community about services and arrangements for visitors.

02

The evening Rosary

Evening prayer offers a chance to give thanks for the day and remember those in need. The evening Rosary forms part of the community’s prayer life. Please use the official contacts to enquire about joining in.
